teaser.en: A true water lily, called 'small toro', whose flowers are used in spiritual healing.
teaser.sw: Yungiyungi halisi, linaloitwa 'toro ndogo', ambalo maua yake hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

summary.en: Toro ndide is a true water lily, a Nymphaea of ponds and pools with round floating leaves and showy flowers. The Digo use its flowers in spiritual healing.
summary.sw: Toro ndide ni yungiyungi halisi, *Nymphaea* wa mabwawa na vidimbwi, wenye majani ya mviringo yanayoelea na maua ya kuvutia. Wadigo hutumia maua yake katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

about.en:
*Toro ndide* is a water lily, rooted in pond mud by a fleshy rhizome. Its round leaves, split at the base, float flat on the water, and its many-petalled flowers open on the surface or just above it.

The exact species was not identified. On the Kenya coast the common water lilies have blue or white flowers. The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Toro ndide* ni yungiyungi, lililotia mizizi katika matope ya bwawa kwa kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) chenye nyama. Majani yake ya mviringo, yaliyopasuka kwenye kitako, huelea bapa juu ya maji, na maua yake yenye petali nyingi huchanua juu ya uso wa maji au juu kidogo yake.

Spishi kamili haikutambuliwa. Katika pwani ya Kenya, mayungiyungi ya kawaida yana maua ya buluu au meupe. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.

where.en: It grows in ponds, seasonal pools and still fresh water on the coastal plain.
where.sw: Hukua katika mabwawa, vidimbwi vya msimu na maji baridi yaliyotulia katika tambarare ya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that the flowers of *toro ndide* and *toro* are used in spiritual healing.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kuwa maua ya *toro ndide* na *toro* hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

culture.en: Water-lily flowers are among the few flowers the Digo use in identifying plants, because of their part in healing.
culture.sw: Maua ya yungiyungi ni miongoni mwa maua machache ambayo Wadigo huyatumia kutambua mimea, kwa sababu ya nafasi yake katika uponyaji.

names.en: Pakia records *toro ndide*, 'small *toro*'. *Toro* is the water lily, and this one is named as the smaller form, with smaller leaves and flowers than the unmarked *toro*, *Nymphoides forbesiana*. No Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *toro ndide*, 'toro ndogo'. *Toro* ni yungiyungi, na hili limepewa jina kama aina ndogo zaidi, yenye majani na maua madogo kuliko *toro* ya kawaida, *Nymphoides forbesiana*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
